g.desc: Panel (a) contains a dynamic scene origin at left, arrow to a spike camera, arrow to a tilted sensor/lattice, spike train arrows, binary spike stream volume, SCSR block, and an HR image stack. Objects progress left to right with approximate horizontal symmetry along the central row.
Right of panel (a) is a stack of grayscale high-resolution images, slanted layers with the foremost layer showing a bus-like scene; rW label marks width.

Panel (b) expands one pixel in the spike camera: photons from scene are gathered into a receptor, integrator, comparator, spike flag, readout circuit, clock, enable signal, and binary output. The drawing proceeds left to right from photons as origin.
Legend lists the color and symbol coding used in panel (c): light intensity, threshold, accumulation, reset, readout time, and spike.

Panel (c) contains three vertically stacked time plots sharing a horizontal time axis: top light intensity curve, middle accumulation with threshold/reset/readout bars, and bottom spike output with binary labels. Symmetry is stacked temporal alignment on common t-axis.
